summary: Iter-41 backend + frontend verification of scraper diagnostics overhaul and new RunRow admin UI. Backend: 11 passed, 1 xfailed (documented accounting bug). Verified TREL Seed Generator collect returns status='success' with fully-populated diagnostics (all 14 required keys), matches_created=12. Verified GET /admin/market/runs?limit=20 tolerates legacy runs with diagnostics=null. Verified rejection contract on the existing Hausples partial runs — rejection_reasons contains no_numeric_price, duplicate_source_id_within_run, no_url_in_card; detail-page math holds (attempted == succeeded + failed, 413 == 413 + 0); pagination_end_reason in the allowed set; pages_visited rows carry required keys. Verified _id is stripped from every /admin/market/* JSON response. Scheduler pause/resume works; regression endpoints (sources, runs, summary, collectors, scheduler, sources/health) all 200. Frontend: all 10 recent runs render with run-toggle-<id>; expanding a Hausples partial row reveals the 8 counter cards (Cards seen 1116, accepted 418, rejected 5809, duplicates 1031, pages 63, detail attempted/succeeded/failed 418/418/0) and 3 rejection badges with correct data-testid (rejection-no_numeric_price, rejection-duplicate_source_id_within_run, rejection-no_url_in_card), plus 'Pagination end' line and 'Pages visited' sub-table. Legacy runs (diagnostics=null) show 'Diagnostics unavailable — this run was recorded before structured diagnostics were introduced.' without crashing. Regression buttons Add Source and Rediscover all present. Evidence page row-click still opens Inspector (38 inspector-* elements). /admin/market/audit renders.

critical.issue: MarketMeri collector visited 70 pages (35 pagination pages followed) and closed as status='success' but with cards_seen=0, cards_accepted=0, records_passed_to_ingestion=0. The extractor is finding zero cards on every listing page — the marketmeri collector's card selectors appear to be broken against the current live site. Contrast with Hausples which correctly extracts 20 cards/page. Diagnostics correctly reports 'no_next_link' pagination_end_reason so the framework itself is fine; the site-specific parser is the defect.

minor.issue: Diagnostics accounting invariant does NOT hold: cards_accepted (413) + cards_rejected (1519) = 1932 but cards_seen = 682, and sum of per-page pages_visited[*].cards_seen also = 682. Rejection reasons breakdown (no_numeric_price=969 + duplicate=550 = 1519) suggests the aggregate cards_rejected is counting each re-encounter/duplicate independently while cards_seen only counts first-sighting per URL. Either cards_seen should include repeat encounters, or duplicates should not double-count into cards_rejected. This makes the acceptance panel misleading (rejected > seen looks broken to a user).

action_items: Fix MarketMeri collector's card extractor: 70 pages visited, 0 cards seen — site parser is broken (report as HIGH; scraper coverage is materially reduced without it).

Reconcile the diagnostics accounting so cards_accepted + cards_rejected == cards_seen (or explicitly document that rejection_reasons is an event count, distinct from unique-cards seen — and label the UI accordingly to prevent operator confusion).

rca_of_the_issue: 1) MarketMeri: the site-specific card selector inside core/collectors/marketmeri.py (or the shared _common extraction path when collector='marketmeri') is not matching the current DOM — the framework's pagination is working (70 pages visited, no_next_link termination) but the card extractor returns 0. 2) Diagnostics math: cards_seen is being incremented once per (url,card) tuple deduped in-page, while cards_rejected/rejection_reasons are incremented on every rejection event (including cross-page duplicate re-encounters that increment duplicate_source_id_within_run). Either both should count events, or both should count uniques.
